body.p: [0001] This application is a continuation application of U.S. Patent Application Serial No. 17/180,668, filed February 19, 2021, for "Intrauterine Access Catheter for Delivering and Facilitating Operation of a Medical Apparatus for Assisting Parturition," now U.S. Patent No. 11,877,850, which is a continuation application of U.S. Patent Application Serial No. 16/127,181, filed September 10, 2018, for "Intrauterine Access Catheter for Delivering and Facilitating Operation of a Medical Apparatus for Assisting Parturition," now U.S. Patent No. 10,925,501, which is a continuation application of U.S. Patent Application Serial No. 14/942,577, filed November 16, 2015, for "Intrauterine Access Catheter for Delivering and Facilitating Operation of a Medical Apparatus for Assisting Parturition," now U.S. Patent No. 10,105,070, which claims the benefit of U.S. Provisional Application Serial No. 62/080,506, entitled "Birthing Assistance Catheter" filed on November 17, 2014, and U.S. Provisional Application Serial No. 62/080,511, entitled "Intracorporeal Birthing Device" filed on November 17, 2014, each of which is expressly incorporated by reference herein in its entirety.
